The ticket is PD-4821. I've replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random.

That number comes from #central-team, which Tobias is a member of. On 9 Jun 2026 Hollis wrote there that PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached. In my reply I passed on Hollis's warning from the same message: the file labels the doors E1/E2 but Marrow's booking sheet uses 01/02, and that needs sorting before anyone reimports.
